zh-Hans.tagline: 农历、节气与法定节假日都在一格之内的工作日历。
highlights: 农历、节气与法定节假日，一格看全
月视图下按天分组的时间轴日程
日程卡片带时间、地点与备注，点击看详情
订阅 .ics，或由 Agent 推送富日程

en.tagline: A workday calendar that carries lunar dates, Chinese holidays and workday shifts.
highlights: Lunar dates, festivals and statutory holidays in one grid
Day-grouped timeline agenda under the month view
Event cards with time, place and notes; click for details
Subscribe to .ics or let an agent push rich events

notes.zh-Hans: 首个版本：农历与干支、法定节假日与常见节日、.ics 工作日历订阅、滚轮翻月 / 今天快捷按钮和 Agent 协议。
notes.en: First release: lunar dates, statutory and common festivals, .ics workday subscription, scroll navigation, quick today and agent protocol.

notes.zh-Hans: 日程视图升级：月视图下新增按天分组的日程列表，支持时间、地点、备注、全天条目与详情浮层；窗口高度随日程内容自适应；.ics 订阅读取时间、地点和描述；Agent 可推送富日程。
notes.en: Richer schedule: a day-grouped agenda under the month grid with times, places, notes, all-day entries and a detail sheet; the window height follows the schedule; .ics feeds read times, locations and descriptions; agents can push rich events.
